report_header.title: LASI project closeout: Mercury
report_header.execution_backends_used: local; authorized Kaggle CLI submission feedback

executive_summary.summary: Mercury was intentionally closed by the project owner with outcome cancelled / approval_block. Direct GBDT is the best recorded comparable local result (RMSLE 0.4609337296) and has a recorded Kaggle public score of 0.49942 (submission 55489163); both are evidence only, not deployment or production evidence.

content.primary_diagnosis: Further containment-path work could not proceed because no actionable approved isolated host profile or challenge-data-transfer boundary existed.
content.recommended_next_action: Do not execute further Mercury work. A reopening requires a new owner decision and separately recorded approvals.

current_decision.summary: The project owner instructed LASI to end the project and report after the isolated-host-profile and challenge-data-transfer boundary remained non-actionable.

dataset_summary.summary: The frozen benchmark dataset version is mercury-store-sales:v1: seven hashed official Store Sales assets in a read-only local workspace. No labels, splits, source data, or benchmark data were changed.

dataset_characterization.summary: A structural profile was recorded. It found 3,000,888 train rows, 28,512 test rows, 54 stores, 33 families, no train/test date overlap, and 939,130 zero sales rows. A full characterization beyond the recorded profile is not available.
